_comment: Exception rules that belong to THIS project, not to one launch configuration. The debugger finds this file because .vscode/launch.json names the project through `delphiProjectFile`; it is read before that configuration's own `exceptionRules` and before the machine-wide file, first match wins. Personal overrides go in Debugme.ExceptionSettings.local.json, which is gitignored. Strict JSON only -- this is not launch.json, so no comments and no trailing commas.
